mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected corporate cash flows and thereby producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat despite FEDFUNDS > 5.25% for ≥3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) of at least 10,000 accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% simultaneously signals a strengthening labor market, which elevates consumer confidence and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative despite the labor signal persisting for ≥2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average, accompanied by a decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL), indicates robust supply-side strength without price pressures, which supports equity valuations and produces positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > INDPRO_12mo moving average AND CPIAUCSL < CPIAUCSL_12mo moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the dual signal persisting for ≥3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200K units in a month, in the absence of a corresponding decline in industrial production (INDPRO), suggests a supply shock that compresses valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1,200K AND INDPRO does not decline
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative when the signal is present.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% for three consecutive months, without a corresponding rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL), indicates a labor market expansion that the Fed may not counter with rate hikes, supporting equity valuations and positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% for 3 consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL flat or rising
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the unemployment signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 in a month, followed by a sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), creates a strong labor market momentum that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >200,000 AND UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive despite the labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 10-year Treasury yield (implied by FEDFUNDS dynamics) below 3.5% for two consecutive months signals a low-rate environment that supports equity risk appetite, producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when the yield signal persists.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% with no significant change in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests deflationary pressure that reduces discounting of future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2% for 2 consecutive months AND INDPRO unchanged for same period
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite the deflationary signal.
